parameters.query:
INSERT INTO raw_reviews (product_name, rating, review_summary, review_text)
VALUES (
  $${{ $json.product_name }}$$,
  {{ $json.rating }},
  $${{ $json.review_summary }}$$,
  $${{ $json.raw_text }}$$
)
RETURNING id;

INSERT INTO processed_reviews (raw_review_id, product_name, sentiment_label, sentiment_confidence, topics, complaint_summary, review_summary, needs_review)
VALUES (
  {{ $json.raw_review_id }},
  $${{ $json.product_name }}$$,
  $${{ $json.sentiment_label }}$$,
  {{ $json.sentiment_confidence }},
  $${{ $json.topics }}$$::jsonb,
  $${{ $json.complaint_summary }}$$,
  $${{ $json.review_summary }}$$,
  {{ $json.needs_review }}
);
